subject: Function-address-identifier
notes: kb/Work PB1416 (landed w1014 group S). 8.4.3.12.2 `ADDRESS OF FUNCTION { function-prototype-name-1 | identifier-1 }` (OF not underlined); identifier-1 is any identifier format (8.4.3.1.3 SR1). The lexer no longer types the '(' after `ADDRESS [OF] FUNCTION word` as the 8.4.3.2.3 SR6 argument paren (a prototype name takes no argument list), so a subscripted (`WS-NAME(2)`, `WS-NAME (N)`, OF omitted) and a reference-modified identifier-1 parse and resolve to the function their content names (golden: SUBSCRIPT-OK, NO-OF-OK, REFMOD-OK).
